workstream: P5 / AC1018-AC1021 TABLE title/header/data row-alignment overrides

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.domain: ODA v5.4.1 §20.4.101.3 documents alignment values 1 through 9.

implementation.behavior: DRW_Table retains the three selected row alignments in a typed array and resets/copies them with the model. Values outside 1..9 leave the record readable but semantically incomplete. Strict DXF output rejects these masks pending a lossless mapping from table-level style overrides to serialized cell values.
implementation.generatedControl: From-scratch AC1021 TABLE vector selects all three alignment and all three row-height fields, verifies exact retained values, body boundary and following sentinel.
implementation.outputControl: ASCII/Binary output verifies atomic refusal for selected unmapped row-height/alignment fields, destination preservation, corrected same-adapter retry and readback.

limits: Generated codec consistency only; no physical producer witness or whole-drawing qualification.
No row alignment DXF mapping or native TABLE rendering/style behavior is established.
Row-height values remain output-ineligible pending their own mapping proof.
Table color/fill/text-style and border override fields remain incomplete.
next: Establish a lossless DXF representation before enabling either row-height or row-alignment output; continue with another override group only with its typed storage and selected-output proof.
